decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposal, is acceptable and would not have a harmful impact upon the vitality and viability of Brentford High Street or harm the surrounding area and neighbours' living conditions. It therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), S.1.1 (Main shopping areas) and S.1.3 (New Retail Development) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The premises shall not be used for the sales of food, other than sundry sales or food for pet animals and birds, or the sale of alcohol by Majestic Wine Warehouses in minimum purchases of twelve bottle of Wine/spirits or a manufacturer's pack of beer, and ancillary items.
description: Variation of condition 15 of planning permission 00707/AL/P3 to allow for the sub division of premises and sale of wine, beer, spirits and sundry items on existing site
